product_risk_or_requirement: Healthcare AI high-risk classification and compliance documentation
current_state: Vietnam AI Law 134/2025/QH15 is enacted but specific healthcare AI requirements require mapping
product_requirement: Complete regulatory classification mapping the MediGuide system to Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg high-risk AI list with compliance gap analysis
acceptance_criteria: Given the MediGuide product scope and target markets When classification review is conducted Then official documentation maps each feature to applicable law requirements with compliance timeline
evidence_needed: Completed classification memo signed by legal counsel and regulatory classification documentation

product_risk_or_requirement: EU AI Act Annex III conformity assessment for high-risk healthcare AI
current_state: Vietnam regulatory pathway defined but EU requirements require separate assessment
product_requirement: Conformity assessment demonstrating compliance with EU AI Act requirements for high-risk healthcare AI including risk management documentation quality management and post-market monitoring
acceptance_criteria: Given the EU market entry plan When conformity assessment is requested Then evidence package includes all required documentation per Annex III obligations with audit trail
evidence_needed: Conformity assessment report technical documentation and quality management system documentation

product_risk_or_requirement: Physician oversight protocol and human-in-the-loop requirements
current_state: Vietnam law requires human oversight for healthcare AI but specific implementation undefined
product_requirement: Written physician oversight protocol defining who reviews recommendations when escalation is required how disagreements are handled and documentation requirements
acceptance_criteria: Given a high-acuity triage recommendation When the system recommends escalation Then a physician reviewer must acknowledge within 15 minutes with documentation of review outcome
evidence_needed: Signed physician oversight protocol with training records and on-call schedule

product_risk_or_requirement: Adverse event response procedure and incident reporting
current_state: Safety incident response undefined for AI-assisted triage scenarios
product_requirement: Documented adverse event response procedure covering identification reporting escalation root cause analysis and corrective action for AI-related patient safety incidents
acceptance_criteria: Given a potential AI-related safety incident When clinical team identifies the incident Then response protocol activates within 1 hour with incident documentation within 24 hours and root cause analysis within 7 days
evidence_needed: Completed tabletop exercise testing the procedure with documented outcomes and improvements

product_risk_or_requirement: Bias testing and fairness validation across demographic groups
current_state: Historical data bias risks identified but no systematic testing implemented
product_requirement: Comprehensive bias testing across race ethnicity age gender and other protected characteristics before each model deployment
acceptance_criteria: Given a new model version or training data update When pre-deployment testing is conducted Then bias metrics show no statistically significant disparity above 5% threshold for any protected group
evidence_needed: Bias testing report with demographic breakdown and fairness metrics for all protected groups

current_state: AI hallucination risk identified for medication information
product_requirement: Implement retrieval-augmented generation for medication information using only validated medication databases with no generative AI for dosage interaction or contraindication content
acceptance_criteria: Given a medication information query When user requests drug interaction or contraindication information Then the response contains only database-verified content with source citation and no AI-generated interpretation
evidence_needed: Technical documentation of RAG architecture with database source verification test results

product_risk_or_requirement: Patient data privacy and consent framework
current_state: GDPR and Vietnamese privacy law requirements apply but consent mechanism undefined
product_requirement: Patient consent and data protection framework compliant with GDPR for EU users and Vietnamese privacy regulations including data retention deletion and portability rights
acceptance_criteria: Given a user accessing MediGuide When personal health information is collected Then explicit consent is obtained with clear explanation of data use retention and user rights per applicable law
evidence_needed: Privacy impact assessment signed documentation consent flow user testing and legal review
